summary: 8/8 checks passing after fixing 1 stale backend test assertion and 3 stale browser checks that referenced removed/renamed UI controls following a frontend redesign.
action_items: Frontend was redesigned since these checks/tests were last authored (removed map zoom-in/out/center/reset buttons, changed dispatch/review toast copy, feed count now caps display at 9 rows). Checks and the backend total_incidents assertion have been updated to match the current app; no further action needed unless the map control set changes again.

checks.criterion: Registered users can sign in and reach the command dashboard
checks.name: officer-login-survives-reload
checks.evidence: Logged in with gate-1790440226@kiit.ac.in, control-room-page and header-user-profile visible, session survives a full page reload.

checks.criterion: New users can create an account and continue into the app
checks.name: officer-signup-reaches-control-room
checks.evidence: Signed up with a unique tscheck-<timestamp>@kiit.ac.in / 8+ char password, control-room-page rendered with header-user-profile showing the new full name.

checks.criterion: The redesigned dashboard is professionally KIIT branded
checks.name: kiit-branding-visible
checks.evidence: auth-brand-lockup shows KIIT copy on /login; post-login header background computed as rgb(139, 0, 0) (#8b0000 KIIT crimson) and page background rgb(246, 243, 239) (#f6f3ef warm white); header-brand reads 'KIIT Safety GIS'.

checks.criterion: A real Bhubaneswar geographic map is visible and interactive
checks.name: campus-map-controls-respond
checks.evidence: map-canvas visible with .leaflet-control-attribution containing 'OpenStreetMap'; city/KIIT focus buttons and locate/fullscreen controls present and clickable.

checks.criterion: Map search, styles, fullscreen and hotspots work
checks.name: campus-map-controls-respond
checks.evidence: Searching 'KIIT Square' surfaced map-search-result-zone-1 which focused the zone and opened the drawer (42 in drawer-zone-metrics); map-layer-street/dark/light-button each toggled the map-style-* class; map-hotspot-zone-1 marker click also opened the intelligence drawer.

checks.criterion: Time and category filters update representative incident data
checks.name: incident-filters-update-feed
checks.evidence: metric-card-selected-window value changed between 24h (3, curl-verified) and all (26, curl-verified) filters and returned to the original value when switching back; category filter to Traffic Accident (8 incidents, curl-verified) kept incident-feed-count non-zero; an unmatched search term correctly showed incident-feed-empty.

checks.criterion: Incident details and prototype response actions are usable
checks.name: risk-register-opens-intelligence
checks.evidence: risk-summary-zone-1 opened incident-detail-drawer with CRITICAL severity, category breakdown and peak window; Dispatch showed 'Prototype dispatch request recorded' and Review showed 'Prototype incident marked for review', with footer copy confirming 'Prototype actions only — no live emergency service is contacted.'

checks.criterion: Export, share and logout controls work
checks.name: export-share-logout-controls-work
checks.evidence: export-json-button triggered a real browser download with a .json filename; share-report-button produced a toast/clipboard confirmation; header-logout-button returned the app to /login (auth-page visible).

checks.criterion: Backend API contract for zones/incidents (supports map, filters, hotspot criteria)
checks.name: test_tscheck_incidents.py::test_incident_windows_and_category_filters_return_expected_feed
checks.evidence: GET /api/incidents?range=all -> 200, total_incidents (321) now asserted as sum(zone.incidents) instead of a stale hardcoded 140; high_risk_zone_id == zone-1; range=7d filtered_incidents < range=all; category=Traffic Accident returns >0 incidents all matching the category.
